description: Insulation contractor in Piedmont, CA, 10 miles north of our San Leandro base. Attic and crawl space work for hillside homes. Start with a free inspection.
intro: Piedmont is a hillside city about 10 miles north of our San Leandro base, surrounded by Oakland. Hillside lots mean many homes sit over crawl spaces, so crawl space work comes up in a lot of our conversations there. Each job starts with a free inspection and a written estimate.

paragraphs: Piedmont sits about 10 miles north of San Leandro, surrounded by Oakland, and the hillside lots put crawl spaces under many of the homes.
Our crews work those conditions regularly, and the same crew handles every visit.

sections.h2: What Piedmont homeowners call us for
paragraphs: Requests from Piedmont most often cover attic insulation, crawl space encapsulation and insulation for walls and garages.
bullets: Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers

paragraphs: We inspect first and quote second. The written estimate is fixed, and the crew that inspects your house is the crew that does the work.
bullets: Free inspection with a written estimate
We come back after the install to confirm the work held

faqs.a: Yes. Piedmont is about 10 miles north of our San Leandro base, inside our usual service area.

faqs.q: Do hillside homes need different insulation work?
faqs.a: Hillside homes often have crawl spaces under part of the house, so crawl space sealing and vapor barriers come up more often. The inspection shows what yours needs.

faqs.q: Do you replace old attic insulation in Piedmont?
faqs.a: Yes. We remove old or damaged material and install new insulation to current standards.
